clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for self-closing taps with or without stuffing box.

clauses.title: Nominal size – 15
clauses.text: 2. Nominal size - 15 mm and 20 mm.  Nominal size shall refer to the nominal bore of the inlet connection.

clauses.title: Design – The opening
clauses.text: 4. Design - The opening of the tap shall be performed by hand pressing of the handle up or down or turning sideways or by pressing in of the pushbutton, and the tap shall close when the handle or pushbutton is released.  The force required for operating the selfclosing tap for its full opening shall not exceed 70 N. For self-closing tap which operate against heads exceeding 2 m, a non-concussive function is essential and provision to this effect shall be made in the design.

clauses.title: Finish – All machining
clauses.text: 5. Finish - All machining shall be so carried out that the parts are true to shape and are in correct adjustment when assembled.  All machined surfaces shall be smoothly finished.  If the body is of lead tin bronze, the outside surface shall be polished bright.

clauses.title: Shall withstand an internelly applied hydraulic
clauses.text: 6.1 Shall withstand an internelly applied hydraulic pressure of 2MPa for a minimum period of 2 minutes without leakage or sweating. clauses.title: Endurance Test
clauses.text: 6.2 Endurance Test — Shall not show any leakage or failure of  the spring or other working parts after 50,000 operations
